g.text: GitLab CI tests every change and releases every version tag to Cloud Run - no stored keys, no manual steps
changes to docs or notebooks only start no pipeline
tag -> live in about 7 minutes (404-408 s for v1.2.0-v1.3.1)
jobs act as the least-privilege deployer service account
No service-account keys anywhere: GitLab issues a short-lived OIDC token per job, and Google accepts it only for this project on protected tags. One version = one tested, immutable image.
